mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM wms_sales_outbound_order o LEFT JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = o.erp_tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_tenant op ON op.id = t.parent_wms_tenant_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_logistics_product lp ON lp.id = o.logistics_product_id WHERE o.id = #{id}
mapper.sql: p.id, p.outbound_order_id AS outboundOrderId, o.outbound_no AS outboundNo, p.erp_order_id AS erpOrderId, p.platform_order_id AS platformOrderId, p.platform, p.shop_id AS shopId, s.name AS shopName, p.erp_tenant_id AS erpTenantId, t.tenant_name AS ownerName, t.parent_wms_tenant_id AS operatorId, op.tenant_name AS operatorName, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, p.sort_slot_id AS sortSlotId, p.sort_slot_scan_code AS sortSlotScanCode, p.sort_code AS sortCode, COALESCE(item_summary.skuKinds, 0) AS skuKinds, COALESCE(item_summary.totalQty, 0) AS totalQty, p.label_status AS labelStatus, p.pack_status AS packStatus, COALESCE(p.ship_status, 'PENDING') AS shipStatus, CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.ship_status, 'PENDING') = 'SHIPPED' THEN 'SHIPPED' WHEN p.pack_status = 'PACKED' THEN 'PACKED' ELSE 'PENDING_PACK' END AS workStatus, o.document_mode AS documentMode, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.channel_code, ''), NULLIF(lp.product_code, ''), 'AUTO') AS defaultChannelCode, p.channel_code AS channelCode, p.channel_name AS channelName, p.tracking_no AS trackingNo, p.weight, p.packer_name AS packerName, p.shipped_by_name AS shippedByName, DATE_FORMAT(p.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime

FROM wms_sales_outbound_package p INNER JOIN wms_sales_outbound_order o ON o.id = p.outbound_order_id LEFT JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = p.erp_tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_tenant op ON op.id = t.parent_wms_tenant_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN shop s ON s.id = p.shop_id LEFT JOIN wms_logistics_product lp ON lp.id = o.logistics_product_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT outbound_order_id, erp_order_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sku_code) AS skuKinds, COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) AS totalQty FROM wms_sales_outbound_order_item GROUP BY outbound_order_id, erp_order_id ) item_summary ON item_summary.outbound_order_id = p.outbound_order_id AND item_summary.erp_order_id = p.erp_order_id
